property_summary: For any amount and any callee, sendMoney is fire-and-forget: it succeeds (does not revert) even when the callee reverts, because P uses a low-level call and ignores the outcome; the mutant's transfer makes sendMoney revert for such callees, breaking the rule.
change_summary: Use transfer instead of call so that a failing transfer reverts and gas is capped at 2300, changing observable Ether-flow behavior.
